card.name: Section numbers and list breaks in labels
card.fires_on: Digits, spaces and linking words inside numbered section references and cross-reference lists in drug labels, such as (2.1, 8.6) or 5.3 headings. Also fires on a few words just before a list of liver or blood terms.

modes.label: Study codes
modes.description: A digit inside a clinical study identifier.

modes.description: Linking or modifier words inside a list of findings or a heading.
